text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — I'm going to kick off a pilot rollout for model-v11 to a small EU + internal staging audience at 10:00 UTC. Need ops + oncall aware. Plan below, pls ack.

Mira: What's the initial percent and exact audiences? Also, any special guardrails?

Alex: Initial slice: 1% traffic to 'pilot:eu_beta' and 'pilot:staging_internal'. Ramp plan: 1% -> 5% after 30m -> 20% after 3h if signals look good. Guardrails: rollback on >0.5% error increase or latency p99 +50% vs baseline, or if quality eval score drops >3 pts. Kill switch: feature flag pilot/model_v11 -> OFF.

Jamal: Are we doing region pinning or header-based routing? Need to ensure NA traffic is zero for this pilot.

Alex: Region pinned: only EU region pools. We use header 'x-redwood-audience: pilot-eu' for internal staging. NA traffic stays on model-v10. Config snippet for the gate:```yaml
feature_flag: pilot/model_v11
audiences:
  - id: pilot-eu
    region: eu-west-1
    initial_pct: 1
  - id: pilot-staging
    region: eu-west-1
    initial_pct: 1
rollout:
  - after: 30m
    set_pct: 5
  - after: 3h
    set_pct: 20
kill_switch: /api/flags/pilot/model_v11/off
metrics_watch:
  - p50_latency
  - p95_latency
  - p99_latency
  - error_rate
  - quality_eval_change
```

Sophia: PR for the runtime change was merged ~1h ago but not yet deployed to eu pools — deployment window at 09:30 UTC? Ops to confirm. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/4821

ops-bot: infra-check: eu pools have capacity for +20% headroom, GPUs 0.6 spare fraction. Can schedule deploy at 09:30 UTC.

Mira: Oncall, can you add temporary alerts for the pilot? Suggest: error_rate > 0.5% relative, p99 > baseline*1.5, and a custom regression alert on eval set. Also add a slack webhook to #incidents.

oncall-bot: added alerts: pilot/model_v11:error_rate_gt_0.5pct, pilot/model_v11:p99_over_1_5x. Webhook -> #incidents created. Escalation: oncall -> eng-oncall.

Jamal: One more — cache invalidation: model-v11 response shapes identical but tokenization differs slightly. We should invalidate prefix cache for pilot audiences to avoid mixing keys. Command to run on deploy:```bash
rctl cache invalidate --audience pilot-eu --prefix 2026-03-modelv11
```

Alex: Good catch. I'll run that right after deployment. Also running a small smoke test script (2k synthetic queries) against pilot pools and posting metrics.

Sophia: QA will run targeted prompts from the eval set at 10:05 UTC, tagging failures with #model-quality so we can triage.

Mira: Who's owner if we need emergency rollback?

Alex: I'm primary owner for the pilot. Jamal is infra backup. If anything triggers guardrail, ops-bot to flip pilot/model_v11 -> OFF and notify thread.

ops-bot: acknowledged. I will also post an automated rollback checklist if any of the three thresholds breach.

Alex: Thanks — please ack here once you’ve read. I'll proceed with deploy prep at 09:00 UTC and start rollout at 10:00 UTC.

Mira: Ack.

Jamal: Ack, infra ready.

Sophia: Ack, QA on standby.

oncall-bot: oncall duty clear: Pager rotations covered.

Alex: Launch complete log will be posted to this thread with timestamps and the smoke-test summary. Thanks everyone.
